description: This file implements default time domain allocations for PDSCH in 5G NR, including functions to retrieve specific allocation tables based on configuration parameters such as cyclic prefix and DMRS position. It defines static tables for different scenarios and provides functions to access these tables for various RNTI types and search space configurations.

methods.name: s_and_len
methods.description: Helper function to construct ofdm_symbol_range with start and length.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Retrieves the default PDSCH time domain allocation for a given cyclic prefix, row index, and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns the PDSCH time domain list for a given search space configuration, active BWP, and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns the default PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI based on cyclic prefix and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_type0A_common_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns the PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI Type0A common, based on common PDSCH config, cyclic prefix, and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_ra_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns the PDSCH time domain list for RA-RNTI based on common PDSCH config, cyclic prefix, and DMRS position.
